product.description: Monoprice™Compact 4‑Port 100W GaN Charger with 3 USB-C® & 1 USB-A® Ports: For Laptop, Tablets, and PhonesMulti‑Device Fast Charging from a Single Compact Charger Powered by GaN Technology Intelligent Power DistributionThe Monoprice™ Compact 4‑Port 100W GaN Charger with 3 USB‑C® & 1 USB‑A Ports is an all‑in‑one powerhouse that charges multiple devices. With USB Power Delivery technology, two Type‑C® ports supply up to 100W single‑port output‑that’s more than enough to fast charge popular full‑sized notebook computers (like the MacBook Pro®, MacBook Air®, Dell XPS™, and ThinkPad® laptops). It is also powerful enough to charge up to two laptops at once‑a full‑sized one (like a MacBook Pro® laptop) and a lighter‑weight one (like a MacBook Air® laptop). Charge up to 4 devices simultaneously, like phones, tablets, and laptops, with Intelligent Power Distribution technology automatically allocating the optimal amount of power to each device, and never worry about overcharging any device. GaN technology increases power efficiency while shrinking the circuit size, providing a compact architecture perfect for fitting into small spaces or taking with you on the go. The folding prong design is there for easy and travel‑friendly packing.
